description: List the workspace's social posts, newest first, 20 per page: id, working title, status (draft, scheduled, publishing, published, partial, failed), channels, scheduled and published times. Filter by status or by part of the title. Read-only. Use get_content_post for one post's texts and per-channel results; use it to check what is already scheduled before planning more posts.

query.description: Part of a publication's working title.

status.description: Only publications in this state: draft, scheduled, publishing, published, partial (some channels failed) or failed.
